jobs_results.title: Revenue Accountant
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

ABOUT XACTLY

Xactly is the global leader in AI-driven Sales Performance Orchestration. We help enterprise organizations align revenue strategy with execution — connecting planning, incentives, and performance in one Intelligent Revenue Platform. Trusted by industry leading companies worldwide, Xactly empowers sales teams to perform at their peak.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY – Revenue Accountant

In this role, you will be an integral member of our global revenue operations and accounting team in Bangalore, supporting Xactly’s Order-to-Cash lifecycle and revenue accounting. Based in Bangalore, India, and reporting directly to our Revenue Accounting Manager in Bangalore, you will primarily focus on daily revenue recognition duties, deferred revenue reconciliations, and month-end close workflows under US GAAP (ASC 606). Additionally, you will partner closely with our Billing Specialist to assist in sales contract creation, order review, and billing setup—gaining broad, hands-on exposure across the entire revenue lifecycle in a fast-paced global SaaS environment.

 

What You’ll Do

Execute Daily Revenue Recognition Duties: Support day-to-day SaaS revenue accounting, prepare deferred revenue and unbilled AR schedules, and assist in maintaining compliance with US GAAP and ASC 606 guidelines.

Support Contract Creation & Billing Workflows: Collaborate directly with our Billing Specialist/Analyst to review sales orders, create customer contracts, and configure accurate billing schedules within enterprise ERP/CRM systems.

Assist in Month-End Revenue Close: Prepare routine revenue journal entries, balance sheet account reconciliations, and supporting documentation to ensure a smooth and timely month-end close process.

Drive Data Integrity & Cross-Functional Support: Verify the accuracy of sales terms and contract data, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales Operations, Billing, and US finance team members to resolve entry-level discrepancies.

Support Audit & Process Enhancements: Assist in gathering supporting schedules and documentation for external audit requests and contribute to team-wide initiatives to streamline order-to-cash workflows.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Must-Have Skills

3–6 years of core accounting experience, ideally with foundational exposure to revenue recognition principles (US GAAP / ASC 606) or billing operations.

Working knowledge of order-to-cash workflows, contract processing, and general ledger journal entries.

High attention to detail and strong organizational skills with an eagerness to learn and grow within SaaS revenue accounting.

Clear, professional communication skills and English fluency with proven ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.

 

Good-to-Have Skills

Prior exposure to SaaS, tech, or multi-national shared services environments.

Hands-on experience or familiarity with enterprise tools such as Workday ERP, Salesforce, or automated billing/revenue systems.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance (B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance).

 

Why Xactly

 

Benefits And Perks

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Comprehensive Health and Accidental Insurance Coverage

Tuition Reimbursement

XactlyFit Gym/Fitness Program Reimbursement

Free snacks onsite (if you work in office)

Generous Employee Referral Program

Free Parking and Subsidized Bus Pass (a go-green initiative!)

Wellness program

 

OUR VISION:  To power the revenue engine of the companies changing the world.

 

OUR CORE VALUES:  Customer Focus | Accountability | Respect | Excellence (CARE) are the keys to our success, and each day we’re committed to upholding them by delivering the best we can to our customers.

 

Xactly is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Xactly provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. This means we believe in celebrating diversity and creating an inclusive workplace environment, where everyone feels valued, heard, and has a sense of belonging. By doing this, everyone in the Xactly family has the power to make a difference and unleash their full potential.

 

We do not accept resumes from agencies, headhunters, or other suppliers who have not signed a formal agreement with us.

Who are we?


Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 
 


A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.






A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.



Job Summary

We are seeking a strong and experienced statutory accountant with a solid background in financial reporting, IFRS, local GAAP, external audit or technical accounting. The successful candidate will bring a strong accounting foundation, sound judgement and the ability to apply accounting principles across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions. 


Previous experience in CAPEX accounting, fixed assets or project accounting is advantageous, but it is not essential. CAPEX accounting can be learned. More important is an analytical mindset, attention to detail and a natural curiosity to investigate issues, challenge unusual results and understand the drivers behind financial outcomes. 


CAPEX and fixed asset accounting will become the successful candidate’s area of specialisation. The role will support the accounting, reporting and statutory compliance of capital expenditure, fixed assets and capital projects within a multinational environment that reports under US GAAP while also meeting local statutory reporting and financial statement filing requirements. 

This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop specialised CAPEX expertise while applying and expanding strong statutory accounting and financial reporting skills within a dynamic global finance organisation.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced international environment
Experience with fixed asset accounting, CAPEX accounting, project accounting or asset management processes
Exposure to US GAAP reporting requirementsExperience working within a multinational organisation, shared services environment or global finance functionExperience supporting multiple legal entities and jurisdictionsKnowledge of Oracle or other enterprise financial systems
What Will Make You Successful

We are looking for someone who:

Has a genuine affinity for numbers and financial analysisEnjoys investigating discrepancies and understanding the story behind the numbersDemonstrates strong professional curiosity and a willingness to challenge unusual outcomesTakes ownership of issues and follows them through to resolutionCan balance technical accounting requirements with practical business realitiesThrives in a collaborative global environment and continuously seeks opportunities for improvement

Are you a finance professional who thrives on precision, loves solving complex problems, and wants to make a real impact in a globally connected team? If IFRS 17, financial validations, and process improvement get you excited, this could be the perfect next step in your career!

About the Role

As an Accountant III in the IGR Validation and Adjustments team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial results within a dynamic global finance environment. You will support IFRS 17 accounting and reconciliation activities, drive resolution of complex reporting issues, and contribute to meaningful process improvement and finance transformation initiatives. Sr Accountant - Intercompany Accounting

Company Intro 
 
 Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer-facing brands - Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, agoda.com, Rentalcars.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. 
 
 Booking Holdings is currently undergoing a Finance Transformation initiative that will drive effective finance support for business management; promote strong governance and control in the organization; and have a world-class finance organization in terms of execution and efficiency. As part of this initiative, the newly formed Global Business Services team will provide centralized operational accounting processes from our Center of Excellence in Bengaluru, India. This role will be responsible for handling the operational accounting processes for Intercompany accounting. 
 
 {Hybrid & US Shifts} 
 
 What you'll be doing: 
 
 The Senior Accountant, Intercompany will be responsible for: 
  
• Operational accounting spanning the entire intercompany lifecycle. Maintaining the intercompany subledger globally across all brands. 
• Maintaining global intercompany transactions and processes, including ensuring compliance with intercompany policy, intercompany transfer pricing agreements, as well as completeness and accuracy of intercompany accounts. 
• Executing month-end intercompany closing activities to ensure accurate and timely accounting records are maintained. 
• Review of global intercompany transactions and account activities to ensure proper elimination and presentation in consolidated financial statements. 
• Ensuring the quality and integrity of the balance sheet and profit and loss accounts for and the variance analysis for intercompany. 
• Responsible for monthly closing reports, variance analysis and reconciliations for intercompany in accordance with US GAAP and covering the Sox framework, and own the compliance aspect regarding this. 
• Researching and preparing intercompany accounting analyses impacted by new business initiatives create and maintain transfer pricing accounting procedural documentation. 
• Interacting and coordinating with Finance & Accounting teams within BHI Brands to ensure proper accounting treatment and accurate financial results. 
• Partnering with Process Owner, Finance System teams and Tax teams to assist in the implementation of intercompany, transaction automation tooling and integration with accounting systems.  
• Ensuring SOX compliance by adhering to internal control requirements, maintaining documentation of key processes and controls, and enhancing the control environment with effective controls. 
• Supporting internal and external audit requirements. 
• Collaboration with cross-functional teams on various initiatives, including Tax, FP&A, P2P, and OTC teams. 
• Other duties and special projects as required (e.g. automation, process standardization, etc.).  
 What you'll bring: 
  
• Experience in Finance and/or accounting preferably within a Big4 environment and/or multinational corporate environment with 5+ years' of experience  
• Sound knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS and SOx 
• Ability to work across multiple functions and entities to drive governance and process relating to intercompany operations. 
• Excellent communication skills (both oral and written) focused on leading and influencing the global intercompany process team; comfortable to lead a diverse set of peers and stakeholders; conveys a constructive and solution-oriented mindset. 
• Experience working with global teams in different time zones. 
• Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Blackline, SAP, OneStream, preferred. 
• Experience with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace tools, preferred. 
• Experience working in a global organization where leading and driving change across multiple companies is key. 
• Demonstrated ability to multitask and meet deadlines within a fast paced environment. 
• Strong written, verbal communication, and presentation skills. 
• Accountability and Trust. Unquestionable integrity and ethics.  
 Pre-Employment Screening 
 
 If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

This is an accounting role as an Accountant 2 within the Financial Integrity, Transformation & Governance (FITG) organization. The position is responsible for the accounting and monitoring of bad debt reserves across Intuit's primary billing systems, arising from transactional losses (e.g., credit card declines) and other forms of customer non-payment. The role also executes core revenue accounting operations, including deferred revenue and partner payable reconciliations and partner invoicing oversight. The role partners closely with the Credit & Collections team to incorporate updated customer risk information into reserve positions, and ensures reserve balances and revenue-related controls remain within documented materiality and compliance thresholds.


Responsibilities
